content: 9:1-6 Yisas imbigau yurau 12-ende wuriimuriamorei
Ende at wogub Yisas wonou imbigau yurau eng wuriba qiumuni wogub munon toar nob wurimusub ne munon ai igaramor eng qib igoarar qamb wurinonogursiarei.
Ende at wogub wuriimurima iua Qenu mi bibis bigor eng wurinob qamb ne toar nob wurimusub qib igoarar qamb
Wuriimurimb qamb wurinob qamar: “An isub qamb mi ger me baiar, tugotau qiyo, abau boru ger qiyo, a mani qiyo nomon qur qiyo ne mingoan uput nagun qamb me baiar.
An qibi munai mor ger isunon end qas igoi wogub bo der ginam eng wogub tumbigi isar.
Ginam ger isunon eng munon ginam eng an merimotar abari ibag irumban gotent eng bai ariramar. An ende abari munon ginam eng an sinungarunor end qininingubour.”
Ende wuri irun wab waga wogub wuri der munai ginam-ginam isub qob uber wurinob qamb a toar nob wurimusub qib igurei.
9:7-9 Herot Yisas musub imbigib qamarei
Ende at qib igamari munon qei der king Herot Galili ai qoat igoar eng nob qamamir: “Yon bo igomot der bugab at qib igo,” ende qamarari Herot mingong irarei.
Ende aba qei der qamamir: “Elaiya bo der ebet qib igo” qamamir, a qei qamamir: “Munon qob gigit qamb igour qoan umburiamir eng ger bo igomot der at qib igo.”
Ende qamb abari Herot der qamar: “Ye Yon quman soopurmine umor eng bo eng your ende at qiroa qob toau igoum?” Ende qamb Yisas gib qamb at qib igoai.
9:10-17 Yisas munon yurau aib 5,000-ende mani wuriserei
Qen end Yisas wonou imbigau yurau wuriimuriamor eng qibi diab mi gugum ebet qib igour eng nob qamarari igub wogub bo oromar wurinou gari ginam aib ger Betsaida end isumirei.
Isari munon yurau aib qob toau igub wuritoar isumirei. Isub geari mismisir ne Qenu wonou bibis end igour end wuriimbig ne toar munon yaremir eng wurimusub ende at igoai.
Ende at igama igoi ituramba gab wonou imbigau yurau eng yar Yisas nob qamamir: “Seger ai e gab munon yurau eng wuriimurima qoounor. Iua wurinou ginamt mi gab nunor.”

Ende qamarari Yisas der wurinob qamar: “Ende ue, aninou mi wurisari nunor.” Ne wuri qamamir: “In mani parau 5-ende ne yagwai ombur-ombur gari igo, eng munon yurau ete eng qeemben ue. End ne, ne qamara in bo is mani bo taui badi e nob sori werisun eng bais qeemben nami ende.”
Munon yurau eng igour eng 5,000-ende. Ne Yisas wonou imbigau yurau eng wuri nob qamar: “Munon wurinob qamarari qarangaret 50, 50-ende bugomunor.”
Qamara ne ende abari bugeramirei.
Ne Yisas mani parau 5-eng ba ne yagwai ombur eng ba matar asi Qenut qebi qamb ne boroumi wonou imbigau yurau eng wurisa baub munon yamangar wurisemirei.
Wurisari mom nub mani tatau wagari imbigau yurau eng mani tatau usisi tugar 7-ende tugarimari diarei.
9:18-20 Pita Yisas qanam musub imbig qamarei
Ende at wogub qen geret Yisas wonomai Qenut qamb igama wonou imbigau yurau eng wot yarari qamar: “Munon yurau aib eng yet mai qamarari igub igoumon?”

Ende qamara wuri qamamir: “Qei nenet Yon munon ya obotar qib igoar eng, ne qei nenet Elaiya, ne qei munon Qenu qamara miteri qamb igour qoan umburiamir eng ger igomot der bugab at qib igo ende net qamb igour.”
Ende qamarari ne wurinou sir bo wuriqebi qamar: “Ende eng an yet your qamb igoumon?” Ende qamara Pita der qamar: “Ne Qenu wonou munon yurau wuriubersiau tari eng ne.”
9:21-27 Yisas gitgoan uter wara uminer end qamarei
Ende qamara Pita at munon qei wurinob qemeriner qamb qoronob nob taisi wogub bo imusi qamar:

“Munangit Wau sig borusi qugurageteriba. Ende aba munon baraitari ne munon mian yamau gigit eng ne qomon imbigau eng der mogirt wab wogub waramari uminerei igo qen ombur gari uma bo igomot der bugemba.”
Pita gari ende nob qamb wogub bo gugum wurinob qamar: “Munon ger ye yenob qib igorib eng wonomit misir me iginer. Quguraget gab eng end misir igub me weginer. Qenen ye yewapet ye toat qiriner.
Munon ger wonomit igub wonou git goan me duieminer eng, mom umiba. A munon ger yet igub wonomi duieminer eng qenen bebereg igoriba.
Ne munon ger mi uber-uber ba ye mom sau binat qamb igoriner eng bo wonou qau borusieriner eng mi eng gagar der bo maigas nonogursieriba? sig ue.
Ne munon ger yet qinining qiyo, yonou qob munon wurinob qemerib qinininginer eng Munangit wau gor qen geret wonou qiribiten ne ur ne enger wurinou qiribi eng ten darab wo gor gab qininingiba.
End ne ete qemerine igar. An e igoumon eng qei igom igo Qenu wonou bibis eng aba gab wogub umuboumon.”
9:28-36 Yisas gitgoan igeseramorei
Yisas wo mi eng ende wurinob qamb wogub igamari inorou gari uma ne Pita ne Yon ne Yems ende oromar Qenut qebi qomorub qamb ai qaur geret iramirei.
Irab qebi qamb igo Yisas menman wes bura geari ne wonou mingoan gor sig oan qenengi nob burerei.
Ende aba gab igamari munon ombur-ombur diab Yisas nob qobub igurei. Munon eng ger Moses ne ger Elaiya.
Ombur qiribiten der Qenu Yisast mi Yerusalem end ebeiner qamb qamar end nob qamb igurei.
Pita munon ombur eng nob mungam igara inub at igamari Yisas mi wes eng aba munon ombur der nob qobub igamari ibag bo asi ibag igurei.

Ibag igamari Moses Elaiya nob qoaubari ibag Pita der Yisas nob qamar: “Barai, in mon ombur gari ginam et mindaun eng uber. Ger nenet ne ger Mosest ne ger Elaiya wonou.” (Pita eng qamar eng misir igub me qamarau, song ar qamb igoai).
Pita qob eng ende qamb igama waber ger der wuriumima gab borusi yariamirei.
Ende aba qob toau ger waber erobon end ete qamara igumirei: “Munon eng yonou wau ten, wo ye anit maribigataremei, wo qob qamara igetet igoarar.”
Qob toau eng ende qamb waga gamir eng munon ger me igamau, Yisas wonamai igama gamirei. Gab tumbet wogub qob ger me qamarau, ne gor munon ger bais me nob qamarau.
9:37-45 Yisas wau ger musub ne wonou uminer end bo qamarei
Urigerma ai qaur eng wogub qumo darari munon yurau aib Yisas gub qamb diamirei.

Dearari munon ger erobon end der atag qamb ar: “Barai, munon e yonou wau ten gari qas e gab nonob quraum. Aibigau waramor eng ten igo nob yogora qenen qob isi qamb ab ne waramb arir igo. Ende aba qenen mu badi qabarit waramb aba qand me uberet igo.
End ne nonou wuri imbigau yurau e wurinob qemerine musiorun qamb obour eng maigas me uberburinerei eng gab wugurei.”
Ende qamara Yisas taui qamar: “An munon oau apand ue, soageni abau sisinam. Ye qen mai-mai aninob igo quguraget qib igoribam?” Ende qamb wau ur nob qamara wau mot isorei.
Isub igama aibigau ten igoar end ba ai qenen qumo arirama borusi aruarei. Ende aba Yisas aibigau taisi qamara wau wogub qoa wau musub wogub urt imuriamorei.
Ende aba munon yamangar Qenu wonou gagam eng gab qiet ne mi gugum ebeteriamor end misir qebebi igub isub igamari Yisas der wonou imbigau yurau eng wurinob qamar:
“Ye qob e aninob qemeribam eng an me nasiarar. Umi-umi Munangit Wau wonou ur eng duima munon qarau waramari umiba.
Eng qamar eng qanam meimet qamb qamar eng wuri sir me imbig qebi qamarau end qubig igurei.
9:46-48 Your aib gigit igo?
Ne wonou imbigau yurau eng der your wurinou baraitari gigit igoriner qi ende qamb agunub igurei.
Wurinou misir eng Yisas imbig wogub wau ger ba qubei nagasi ne wurinob qamar:
“Munon ger yet igub wau e musieriner eng ye yemusub igo. Ne imusi ye yemusub igo eng tain ye yiimurima derem eng gor musub igo. Munon ger wau qomourt e gas ende igoriner eng baraitari gigit igoriba.”
9:49,50 Munon ger me neqarausieriner eng nonou munon banam
Ende qamara Yon qamar: “Barai, in munon ger gaun eng neunumot aibigau munon ger waramor eng musia uberbura gab in yurau et me ininob qib igo, eng wo gituturunei.”
Ende qamara Yisas taui qamar: “An me gitatatar, munon ger an me qarausi igo eng aninou munon banam,” ende qamarei.
9:51-56 Samaria munon Yisas qarausiamirei
Ne Qenu Yisas bo iriner qamb qen mari bigeteter eng pi bura gab Yerusalem isib eterei.
End ne gim biga gigit isorei. Munon eng gim isumir eng is Samaria wurinou ginam geret isub mi arsiorub isumirei.
Isari munon ginam eng Yisas Yerusalem isib ater end munai me wuriimbigau.
Ende abari wonou imbigau munon ombur eng, Yems Yon nob der Yisas nob qamamir: “Barai, ne mai misir igan? Munon ginam eng obour eng in Qenu nob qomurune mut aba der wuri oa umb uburunor qiyo?”
Ende qamarari Yisas wuritaisi wogub ginam eng wogub ginam taut isumirei.
9:57-62 Yisas nob qib igamau werei end qamarei
Qataben isub igamari munon ger diab Yisas nob qamar: “Ye ne nob ten qib igoribam.”
Ende qamara Yisas nob qamar: “Iau qaar wuri irut igour a morogan wuri nam erer mon ubet igour. Ne munangit wau wo bugab umieminer eng munai ger ue.”
Ende qamb ne bo munon ger nob qamar: “Ne ye nob qib igorun.” Ende qamara munon eng nob qamar: “Ue, yiimurima isub tain umar eng tumuni wogub nonob qib igoribam.”

Ende qamara Yisas nob qamar: “Eng wog, munon umour eng qei igom igour eng yet me oabigour eng wurinou qi tumuni igorunor. Ne isub munon yamangar ete wurinob qem: “An Munon aib wot oabigari anubersia wonou bibis end igoruboumon,” ende wurinob qamara igunor,” ende qamarei.
Ne bo munon ger di qamar: “Ye mom nonob qib igoribam end yiimurima isub yonou wau yamangar qamb eng wuriimbig wogub diab nonob qib igoribam.”
Ende qamara Yisas nob qamar: “Munon ger Qenu wonou bibis eng igorib qamb ebet ne bo igeser mogirt asi eng Qenu bibis eng me ginerei,” ende qamarei.
